title: Kabbalists Meet for Rare Encounter
body: Ashlag Rebbe visits Rav Dovid Batzri's bais medrash, joined by son Rav Moshe Batzri, for a rare meeting of two leading kabbalists and their students.

title: Hamas Captive Marks Spiritual Milestone
body: Russia's Chief Rabbi, Rav Berel Lazar, presided over a bris milah ceremony for Maxim Harkin, a Hamas captivity survivor, in Moscow. Harkin was freed after 738 days and marked the occasion with a new name.
